name: Account Sub Level 24
definition: Provides detailed ownership information about the shareholding quantity to be disclosed,  or the shareholding quantity not to be disclosed and the shareholding quantity below threshold.

NonDisclosedShareholdingQuantity.name: Non Disclosed Shareholding Quantity
NonDisclosedShareholdingQuantity.definition: Quantity of shares for which shareholding details are not disclosed.

BelowThresholdShareholdingQuantity.name: Below Threshold Shareholding Quantity
BelowThresholdShareholdingQuantity.definition: Quantity of shares for which shareholding details are not reported as the quantity of shares owned by the shareholder is under the threshold limit.

Disclosure.name: Disclosure
Disclosure.definition: Details of the account sub-levels and holdings.
